brand.platformNameZh: 想去就出发｜旅行收藏与路线规划
brand.platformNameEn: Want to Go | Travel Save Organizer
brand.subtitleZh: 把收藏的地方，变成真正走得通的旅程
brand.subtitleEn: Turn saved places into a trip you can actually take

privacy.purposeZh: 这些信息只用于确认行程范围、档期、交付时间和后续联系。
privacy.purposeEn: These details are used only to confirm scope, availability, delivery timing and follow-up contact.
privacy.handlingZh: 仅提交目的地、日期、天数、联系方式及必要偏好；由人工查看并跟进，不在此页面收款。
privacy.handlingEn: Only destination, dates, trip length, contact details and necessary preferences are submitted for manual follow-up; payment is not collected on this page.
privacy.boundaryZh: 本服务不代订、不持续监控；出发前复核仅在双方约定的复核日检查一次并列出发现的变化。
privacy.boundaryEn: The service does not book or monitor continuously. The pre-trip review is performed once on the agreed review date and lists any changes found.

copy.sectionTitleZh: 想去库整理好后，也可以交给人工继续排。
copy.sectionTitleEn: Once your want-to-go library is ready, you can ask us to plan each day.
copy.contactPlaceholderZh: 微信号 / 手机号 / 邮箱
copy.notesPlaceholderZh: 人数、步行上限、必去地点、饮食禁忌或住宿区域。
copy.notesPlaceholderEn: Party size, walking limit, must-go places, diet or hotel area.
copy.submitZh: 提交行程需求，不会立即扣款
copy.submitEn: Send itinerary request — no charge now
copy.fallbackPrefixZh: 如果提交后没有看到需求编号，

paymentWorkflow.copyZh: 提交意愿 → 确认范围、档期和交付时间 → 顾客确认 → 单独发送付款方式 → 人工登记付款 → 开始交付
paymentWorkflow.copyEn: Submit interest → confirm scope, availability and delivery time → customer confirms → payment instructions are sent separately → payment is recorded manually → delivery begins

xiaohongshu.requires: xiaohongshu.com 笔记完整链接及 xsec_token；短链仅保留，需补完整链接或截图
xiaohongshu.requiresEn: A full xiaohongshu.com note URL with xsec_token. Short links are retained but require a full URL or screenshot.

ctrip.requires: 链接来源同时提供地点名；用目的地与链接内地点 ID 消歧
ctrip.requiresEn: Provide the place name with the URL. Destination and the place ID in the submitted URL are used for disambiguation.

wechat_official.requires: 可公开打开的公众号文章 URL
wechat_official.requiresEn: A publicly accessible WeChat Official Account article URL.

mafengwo.requires: 保留原链接；安全检测时补截图、保存网页或粘贴文字
mafengwo.requiresEn: The original URL is retained. Provide screenshots, a saved page or pasted text when a security check blocks reading.

douyin.requires: 公开作品链接或分享短链；读取受限时补原视频、截图或文字
douyin.requiresEn: A public video URL or share short link. If public reading is limited, provide the original video, screenshots or text.

tiktok.requires: 公开 TikTok 视频链接；私密、删除或区域受限内容需补原视频、截图或文字
tiktok.requiresEn: A public TikTok video URL. Private, removed or region-restricted content requires the original video, screenshots or text.

instagram.requires: 公开 Instagram 帖子或 Reel 链接；不支持 Story，嵌入元数据不完整时补截图、原视频或文字
instagram.requiresEn: A public Instagram post or Reel URL. Stories are unsupported; provide screenshots, the original video or text when embed metadata is incomplete.

youtube.requires: 公开 YouTube 视频或 Shorts 链接；字幕、完整视频画面与多地点内容需补文字、原视频或带时间戳截图
youtube.requiresEn: A public YouTube video or Shorts URL. Captions, full video scenes and multi-place content require text, the original video or timestamped screenshots.

featuresZh: 截图、链接、视频和文字收纳
按目的地分库与地点卡
基础片区分组、修改与本地导出
featuresEn: Capture screenshots, links, videos and text
Basic area grouping, edits and local export

preTripReview.descriptionZh: 保留为非公开的独立复核能力；客户交付中不设价格卡、购买入口或直接购买表达。¥199 人工服务包含一次双方约定日期的出发前复核。
preTripReview.descriptionEn: Retained as a non-public standalone review capability without a customer-facing price card or purchase entry. The ¥199 manual service includes one review on an agreed date.

manualItineraryBeta.availabilityZh: 内测期限量接单，提交后确认档期
manualItineraryBeta.availabilityEn: Limited beta availability; timing is confirmed after submission
manualItineraryBeta.descriptionZh: 一个城市、3–7 天、2–15 个地点，含一次范围内修改和一次双方约定日期的出发前复核。
manualItineraryBeta.descriptionEn: One city, 3–7 days and 2–15 places, with one in-scope revision and one pre-trip review on an agreed date.
exclusionsEn: No booking on the customer's behalf

copy.onboardingZh: Kornvia 想去就出发已准备好。把本轮旅行截图、公开链接、视频或文字发给我，我会先收进按目的地整理的想去库，不会擅自生成攻略。小红书完整笔记链接、携程地点链接和公开公众号文章会按平台规则读取；马蜂窝遇安全检测时会保留原链接，并请你补截图、保存网页或文字。抖音会读取本轮公开作品页；TikTok 和 YouTube 读取公开视频的公开嵌入元数据；Instagram 支持公开帖子与 Reel，Story 不支持。这四个平台读取受限或资料不足时都会保留原链接，并请你补原视频、截图或文字。多地点文章不会冒充一个地点，需要指定地点名或拆分收纳。需要整理时，说“生成曼谷想去护照”。免费档包含收纳、分库、地点卡与配图、护照、基础片区分组、修改和本地导出。¥199 人工逐日行程内测覆盖一个城市、3–7 天、2–15 个地点，含一次范围内修改和一次双方约定日期的出发前复核；不代订、不持续监控。内测期限量接单，提交后确认档期。
copy.onboardingEn: Kornvia Want to Go is ready. Send travel screenshots, public links, videos or text from this turn and I will save them by destination in your want-to-go library without creating a guide unless asked. Full Xiaohongshu note URLs, Ctrip place URLs and public WeChat Official Account articles use verified platform adapters. If Mafengwo presents a security check, the submitted URL is retained and a screenshot, saved page or pasted text is requested. Douyin reads only public video-page metadata available in the current run. TikTok and YouTube use public embed metadata for public videos. Instagram supports public posts and Reels; Stories are unsupported. If any of these four platforms is blocked or returns incomplete evidence, the original URL is retained and the original video, screenshots or text is requested. Multi-place articles are not presented as one place; name the target place or split the source. The free tier includes capture, destination libraries, place cards and images, passport, basic area grouping, edits and local export. The ¥199 manual itinerary beta covers one city, 3–7 days and 2–15 places with one in-scope revision and one pre-trip review on an agreed date. It does not include booking or continuous monitoring. Beta availability is limited and confirmed after submission.
copy.savedNextStepZh: 想把收藏整理成网页攻略，可以说“生成{destination}想去护照”。
copy.savedNextStepEn: Say “Create my {destination} Want-to-go passport” when you want a shareable web guide.
copy.passportReadyZh: 想去护照已生成。免费档可继续修改、排序、撤销和本地导出。需要人工逐日安排时，¥199 内测覆盖一个城市、3–7 天、2–15 个地点，含一次范围内修改和一次双方约定日期的出发前复核；不代订、不持续监控。内测期限量接单，提交后确认档期。
copy.passportReadyEn: Your Want-to-go passport is ready. The free tier remains editable, sortable, undoable and locally exportable. The ¥199 manual itinerary beta covers one city, 3–7 days and 2–15 places with one in-scope revision and one pre-trip review on an agreed date; booking and continuous monitoring are excluded. Beta availability is limited and confirmed after submission.
